blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Cross-lingual contrastive learning has been a core component of multilingual encoder training, but the ability to explicitly align representations is not possible in decoder-only LLMs because of varying multilingual tokenization. However, a growing amount of research suggests that even in LLMs, higher cross-lingual representational alignment leads to improved cross-lingual transfer. In this paper, we propose a novel approach to reimagine cross-lingual contrastive learning given the architectural constraints of modern LLMs. Rather than applying an auxiliary alignment loss on hidden states, we propose using the outputs of the mixture-of-experts (MoE) routers as the target for alignment. Router outputs lend themselves better to pooling over many tokens, enabling more reliable cross-lingual comparisons at the sequence-level.
Controlled continual pre-training experiments on four open-source MoEs show that incorporating this routing loss also aligns the underlying hidden representations across languages.
Most importantly, this loss improves multilingual performance on our diverse evaluation suite, demonstrating the potential of cross-lingual MoE router alignment.
blocks.zh:
跨语言的对比性学习一直是多语种编码器培训的核心组成部分,但由于多种语言符号化不同,在只解码器的LLM中,明确调和表示的能力是不可能的. 然而,越来越多的研究显示,即使在法学硕士课程中,提高跨语言代表性的校对水平也会导致跨语言转移的改善。 在本文中,鉴于现代法学硕士的建筑限制,我们提出一种新颖的方法来重新构思跨文化的对比性学习。 我们建议使用专家混合路由器的产出作为校正目标,而不是对隐藏状态适用辅助校正损失。 路由器产出更有助于汇集许多符号,从而能够在序列一级进行更可靠的跨语言比较。
在四个开放源码上持续进行受控的培训前试验 教育部表明,将这种路由损失纳入其中,也使各种语言之间的隐藏表述相一致。
最重要的是,这一损失改善了我们不同评价套件的多语种性能,显示了跨语言的教育部路由器对齐的潜力。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Developing LLMs that perform well in natural languages underrepresented during pretraining or post-training remains a major challenge. One longstanding idea is that cross-lingual transfer —the generalization of learned capabilities and knowledge across languages—is closely tied to the alignment of internal representations ( Klementiev et al., 2012 ; Gaschi et al., 2023 ; Liu and Niehues, 2025 ) .
If semantically equivalent inputs in different languages are represented similarly, knowledge and capabilities learned in one language are more likely to transfer to another. In earlier encoder-decoder language models, this idea could be operationalized directly because the encoder produces a natural sequence-level embedding ( Zhou et al., 2016 ) . Given the abundance of parallel (translated) text, cross-lingual contrastive learning could pull the embeddings of translated sentence pairs together while pushing those of unrelated pairs apart. Contrastive learning remains standard practice for training multilingual encoders ( Wang et al., 2024a ; SONAR Team et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh:
制定在培训前或培训后表现优异的自然语言课程仍然是一项重大挑战。 一个长期的想法是,跨语言的交流——跨语言的学习能力和知识的普及——与内部表述的一致性密切相关(Klementiev等人,2012年;Gaschi等人,2023年;Liu和Niehues,2025年)。
如果以不同语言提供的类似内容,则以一种语言学到的知识和能力更有可能转移到另一种语言。 在早期的编码器-解码器语言模型中,这个想法可以直接操作,因为编码器会产生自然序列级嵌入(周等人,2016年). 鉴于并行文本的丰富性,跨语言的对比性学习可以将翻译成的句子的嵌入物拉在一起,同时将无关的句子的嵌入物推开. 相互矛盾的学习仍然是培训多语种编码员的标准做法(Wang等人,2024a;SONAR)。 Team等人, 2026; Zhang等人, 2025).

blocks.en: However, modern LLMs are decoder-only models. Consequently, they provide no natural sequence-level representation to align, and differences in tokenization and linguistic structure make it difficult to match tokens across translations. Common approaches to constructing sequence representations include using the final token’s hidden state or mean-pooling hidden states ( Li et al., 2024 ; Zheng et al., 2026 ) , but neither reliably represents the meaning of the entire sequence. As a result, multilingual LLMs are typically trained without an inductive bias toward cross-lingual representational alignment, leaving the vast supply of translation data underutilized. Even so, these models implicitly learn language-agnostic representations, particularly in their middle layers ( Wendler et al., 2024 ; Zhao et al., 2024 ; Bandarkar et al., 2026c ) . The extent to which models use these shared representations varies significantly across languages, and a growing body of work argues that poor cross-lingual alignment is directly tied to poor performance in those languages (See Section 2 ).
blocks.zh: 然而,现代的LLMS只是解码器的模型. 因此,它们没有自然的序列级代表来协调,而标志化和语言结构的差异使得翻译之间的符号难以匹配。 构建序列表达的常见方法包括使用最终符号的隐藏状态或平均集合的隐藏状态(Li et al., 2024; Zheng et al., 2026),但两者都不可靠地代表整个序列的意义. 因此,对多语种法学硕士课程的培训通常不会对跨语种代表性的调整产生诱导性偏见,从而使大量的翻译数据没有得到充分利用。 即使如此,这些模型也隐含地学习了语言不可知性表达,特别是在其中层(Wendler等人,2024年;Zhao等人,2024年;Bandarkar等人,2026年c). 不同语文的模型使用这些共同表述的程度差别很大,越来越多的工作认为,交叉语文的配合不佳与这些语文的绩效不佳直接相关(见第2节)。

blocks.en:
Motivated by these limitations, we present a method for effective cross-lingual alignment using the routers in mixture-of-experts (MoE) components. MoEs have become a prominent LLM architecture ( Team et al., 2023 ; DeepSeek-AI et al., 2025 ) because they enable parameter scaling at a relatively fixed inference cost ( Shazeer et al., 2017 ) . For each token, the router at each layer produces a probability distribution over the available experts, determining which experts to activate. Based on prior research, we hypothesize that mean-pooled routing weights provide strong alignment targets.
We evaluate this hypothesis by developing a training method that performs continual pretraining (CPT) on parallel data with an auxiliary KL-divergence loss over the mean-pooled routing weights of middle layers. We experiment with four MoE LLMs and seven languages. First, through small-scale training runs of 200k samples, we establish that this auxiliary loss effectively increases routing agreement. We also find that its gradients increase hidden-state similarity. Across a diverse set of downstream evaluations, models trained with our auxiliary loss consistently outperform those trained with vanilla CPT. Together, these results provide causal evidence that cross-lingual alignment improves multilingual performance. In practical terms, our method offers an effective and efficient cross-lingual alignment paradigm compatible with any training stage.
blocks.zh:
受这些限制的驱使,我们提出了一种方法,利用专家混合组件中的路由器进行有效的跨语言对齐。 教育部已成为一个突出的LLM架构(Team等人,2023年;DeepSeek-AI等人,2025年),因为它们能够以相对固定的推论成本进行参数缩放(Shazeer等人,2017年). 对于每个符号,每一层的路由器都会产生一个概率分布于现有专家,决定哪些专家可以激活. 根据先前的研究,我们假设 平均集合的路由权重 提供了强大的对齐目标。
我们通过开发一种培训方法来评价这一假设,该方法在中层平均集合路由权重上进行并行数据的连续预训(CPT)和辅助KL潜水损失。 我们试验了4种教育、教育和语言部和7种语言。 第一,通过200k样本的小规模训练,我们确认这种辅助损失有效地增加了路线协议。 我们还发现它的梯度增加了隐藏态的相似性. 在一系列不同的下游评估中,受过附带损失培训的模型,一贯比受过香草CPT培训的模型要好。 这些结果共同提供了因果证据,表明跨语种的配合可以提高多语种的性能. 实际上,我们的方法提供了一个与任何培训阶段相适应的有效和高效的跨语言协调模式。

blocks.en: This paper is organized as follows. We first present recent research that motivates our method in Section 2 and describe its design and implementation in Section 3 . Next, we outline our experiments in Section 4 and present internal metrics and downstream results in Section 5 . Finally, we discuss our findings in Section 6 , and conclusions, and the opportunities they open for future work in Section 7 .
blocks.zh: 本文编排如下. 我们首先介绍最近的研究,它促使我们在第2节中采用这种方法,并在第3节中描述其设计和实施。 接下来,我们概述我们在第4节中的试验,并在第5节中介绍内部的衡量尺度和下游结果。 最后,我们在第6节中讨论了我们的调查结果和结论,以及它们为第7节今后的工作提供的机会。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work and Hypotheses
blocks.zh: 2 有关工作和假设

blocks.en: 2.1 Cross-Lingual Representational Alignment in Encoder Models
blocks.zh: 2.1 编码器模型中的横向代表统一

blocks.en: Because of machine translation research, there has long been a relative abundance of mined parallel data (paired multilingual texts) ( Koehn, 2005 ; Smith et al., 2013 ) . Parallel data was first used to align representations across languages in early word embedding models ( Klementiev et al., 2012 ) . However,languages rarely align at the word level, so later sequence-to-sequence encoder-decoder models benefitted from much more direct supervision ( Zhou et al., 2016 ; Schwenk and Douze, 2017 ; Conneau et al., 2018 ; Ouyang et al., 2021 ; Chi et al., 2021 ) . In these models, parallel data was widely used for cross-lingual contrastive learning, which unified the feature space and facilitated multilingual generalization ( Wu and Dredze, 2020 ; Gaschi et al., 2023 ; Patra et al., 2023 ) . Modern, state-of-the-art multilingual embeddings models continue to leverage such explicit contrastive signals for representation learning ( Sturua et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2024a ; SONAR Team et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) . Though less clean, data augmentation can make contrastive learning also useful for monolingual models ( Wu et al., 2020 ; Kaushik et al., 2020 ; Giorgi et al., 2021 )
blocks.zh: 由于机器翻译研究,长期以来,开采的平行数据相对丰富(多语种文本)(Koehn,2005年;Smith等人,2013年)。 平行数据首先用于在早期文字嵌入模型中调和不同语言之间的表示(Klementiev等人,2012年)。 然而,语言在单词级别上很少对齐,因此后来的序列对序编码器-解码器模型得益于更直接的监管(周等人,2016年;施文克和杜兹,2017年;康诺等人,2018年;欧阳等人,2021年;戚等人,2021年). 在这些模型中,平行数据被广泛用于跨语言对比性学习,这统一了特征空间,促进了多语种的泛化(Wu and Dredze, 2020; Gaschi等人, 2023; Patra等人, 2023). 现代、最先进的多语种嵌入模型继续利用这种明显的对比信号来进行代表性学习(Sturua等人,2024年;Wang等人,2024年a;SONAR)。 Team等人, 2026; Zhang等人, 2025). 虽然不干净,但数据扩充可以使对比性学习也有利于单一语言模型(Wu等人,2020年;Kaushik等人,2020年;Giorgi等人,2021年)。

blocks.en: Highly analogous to the cross-lingual setting, contrastive learning has been a major training component of multimodal embedding models, most famously for image-text representation alignment and data-efficient vision understanding ( Radford et al., 2021 ; Zhai et al., 2023 ) . However, as the field has evolved toward generative multimodal language models, vision-language integration is trained primarily with image-conditioned next-token prediction ( Alayrac et al., 2022 ; Liu et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 与跨语言环境非常相似,对比式学习一直是多式联运嵌入模型的主要培训内容,最著名的是图像文本表述的对齐和数据高效的愿景理解(Radford等人,2021年;Zhai等人,2023年)。 然而,随着该领域向遗传多模式语言模式的发展,视觉语言融合主要通过图像条件化的下一手预测得到培训(Alayrac等人,2022年;Liu等人,2023年)。

blocks.en: 2.2 Multilingual Representations in LLMs
blocks.zh: 2.2 法学硕士中的多种语言代表

blocks.en:
Recent work suggests that multilingual LLMs perform substantial computation in language-shared representational spaces in the middle model layers, while retaining some language-specific structure at the beginning and end ( Kojima et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) . Recent work further shows that increasing cross-lingual alignment can improve multilingual generalization through activation patching ( Lim et al., 2025 ; Ravisankar et al., 2026 ) , hidden-state steering ( Zhao et al., 2025 ; Gurgurov et al., 2025 ; Mahmoud et al., 2025 ) , and router steering in MoE models ( Bandarkar et al., 2026c ) . However, stronger alignment can also come at the cost of language and culture-specific information ( Han et al., 2025 ) .
To improve cross-lingual alignment in decoder-only models during training, prior work has increased exposure to parallel translation data ( Zhang et al., 2024 ; Shen et al., 2025 ) .
Similar benefits from parallel data have also been observed for programming languages ( Wu et al., 2026 ) . Closest to this work, Liu and Niehues (2025) does middle layer alignment using a cosine similarity loss with hidden states.
blocks.zh:
最近的工作表明,多语种LLM在中模型层中进行大量语言共享代表空间的计算,同时在开头和结尾保留一些语言特有的结构(Kojima等人,2024年;Wu等人,2025年;张等人,2026年). 最近的工作进一步表明,通过激活补丁(Lim等人,2025年;Ravisankar等人,2026年),隐藏状态引导(Zhao等人,2025年;Gurgurov等人,2025年;Mahmoud等人,2025年),以及MOE模型的路由器引导(Bandarkar等人,2026年c),提高多种语言的通用性。 然而,在语言和文化特定信息方面也可以作出更大的调整(Han等人,2025年)。
为了在培训期间改善唯一解码器模型的跨语言一致性,先前的工作增加了对平行翻译数据的曝光(张等人,2024年;沈等人,2025年)。
并行数据对编程语言也有类似的好处(Wu等人,2026年)。 与本作最接近的是,刘和涅胡斯(2025年)使用与隐藏状态的余弦相似性损失进行中层对齐.

blocks.en: 2.3 Central Hypotheses
blocks.zh: 2.3 中央假设

blocks.en:
Based on these findings, our first hypothesis is, of course, that cross-lingual representation alignment causally improves cross-lingual transfer in modern LLMs.
Our second, more novel hypothesis is that using mean-pooled MoE routing weights across parallel sequences as a target can effectively align model processing across languages.
This rests on the premise that mean-pooled routing weights provide a meaningful sequence-level representation ( Xu et al., 2026 ; Bandarkar et al., 2026a ; Martin et al., 2026 ) . It has a natural interpretation: the overall expert utilization through the sequence.
By contrast, mean-pooling hidden states averages high-dimensional representation vectors, such that token-level features encoded in different directions can be attenuated or cancel under averaging. Li and Zhou (2025) empirically support this distinction, showing that mean-pooled routing weights perform significantly better than mean-pooled hidden states on embedding tasks.
Even if underlying representations remain unaligned, Bandarkar et al. (2026c) finds that promoting more consistent expert usage across languages is beneficial in its own right.
blocks.zh:
基于这些调查结果,我们的第一个假设当然是,在现代法学硕士课程中,跨语种的表述协调因果地改善了跨语种的转移。
我们的第二个,更新颖的假说是,将平均集合的MOE的路由权重跨平行序列作为目标,可以有效地使跨语言的模型处理对齐.
这基于一个前提,即平均集合的路由权重提供了有意义的序列级代表(徐等人,2026年;Bandarkar等人,2026a年;Martin等人,2026年)。 它有一个自然的解释:通过序列的总体专家利用.
相比之下,中间集合隐藏状态平均是高维度的表示向量,这样不同方向编码的符号级特性可以在平均值下减弱或取消. 李 and和周 Zhou(2025年)在经验上支持这种区分,表明在嵌入任务上,平均集合的路由权重比平均集合的隐藏状态表现要好得多.
即便基本表述仍然不一致,Bandarkar等人(2026年c)认为,促进不同语文之间更加一致的专家使用本身是有益的。

blocks.en: 3 Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Middle Layers Selection
blocks.zh: 3.1 中层选择

blocks.en:
For each model, we use cross-lingual routing divergence curves following Bandarkar et al. (2026c) , to identify layers that already exhibit expert sharing across languages and apply the auxiliary router loss to the corresponding layers. This provides a principled way to select these layers without exhaustively searching over the combinatorially-large space of possible layer subsets. Bandarkar et al. (2026c) show that these curves identify layers where cross-lingual alignment is beneficial and layers where enforcing alignment can be detrimental.
We therefore select a range of middle layers ℳ \mathcal{M} for each model and hold it fixed across all experiments (see Appendix C for more details).
blocks.zh:
对于每个模型,我们使用Bandarkar等人(2026c)之后的跨语言路由差曲线,来识别已经显示专家在语言之间共享的层,并将辅助路由器丢失应用于相应的层. 这提供了一种原则性的方法,可以选择这些层,而不详尽地搜索可能分层的组合空间。 Bandarkar等人(2026年c)表明,这些曲线可识别出跨语言对齐有益和强制对齐有害的层次。
因此,我们为每个模型选择一系列的中层M\ mathcal{M},并在所有实验中保持固定(详见附录C)。

blocks.en: 3.3 Packing Optimizations
blocks.zh: 3.3 包装优化

blocks.en:
A naive implementation requires separate forward passes for the source and target sequences to compute the routing-alignment objective, followed by an additional target-language pass for the LM objective (Figure 2 , left).
Because English has lower token fertility on average, especially compared to the non-Latin-script languages we experiment with, the second forward pass is already less expensive.
But we compute both objectives in a shared forward pass by packing source and target sequences together without padding (Figure 2 , right). Variable-length attention preserves sequence boundaries, while our split-forward implementation stops processing source tokens after the last alignment layer.
Together, these optimizations eliminate padding and redundant computation, resulting in only a small computational overhead relative to our baseline single-language CPT.
blocks.zh:

由于英语的平均象征生育率较低,尤其是与我们试验的非拉丁语语言相比,第二次前传已经比较便宜了.
但是,我们用一个共享的前进通道来计算两个目标,通过包装源和目标序列一起计算,而不进行粘贴(图2,右)。 可变长的注意保留了序列边界,而我们的分位前执行则在最后一个对齐层后停止处理源令牌.
这些优化加在一起,消除了补丁和冗余计算,导致相对于我们的基线单语CPT,只产生一个小的计算间接费用.

blocks.en: 4.1 Models, Languages, and Training Data
blocks.zh: 4.1 模式、语言和培训数据

blocks.en:
Our goal is to experiment with a diverse set of models and languages. To this end, we work with Qwen3-30B-A3B ( Yang et al., 2025 ) , GPT-OSS-20B ( OpenAI, 2025 ) , Granite-4.0-H-Tiny ( IBM Granite Team, 2025 ) , and Marco-Nano ( Jiang et al., 2026 ) . Their MoE configurations are detailed in Appendix D . For the two smaller models, Granite and Marco, we experiment with Vietnamese, Sinhala, and Hungarian. For the two larger models, we use Telugu, Kannada, Thai, and Kyrgyz.
Because our experiments involve only a short CPT stage, we restrict evaluation to target languages in which the base models already exhibit non-trivial proficiency.

我们的目标是尝试一套多样的模型和语言. 为此,我们与Qwen3-30B-A3B(杨等人,2025年),GPT-OSS-20B(OpenAI,2025年),Granite-4.0-H-Tiny(IBM Granite Team,2025年),以及Marco-Nano(Jiang等人,2026年)合作. 其MOE配置详见附录D. 对于两个较小的模型,Granite和Marco,我们用越南语,僧伽罗语和匈牙利语进行实验. 对于两个更大的模型,我们使用泰卢固,坎纳达,泰语,吉尔吉斯语.
因为我们的实验只涉及一个简短的CPT阶段,我们把评价限制在那些基础模型已经表现出非三角能力的语言上.

blocks.en: We construct a curated parallel training set of 200k samples for each language. We construct each training set from diverse, high-quality parallel sources. Whenever fewer curated examples are available, we supplement the training data with the OPUS translation dataset ( Tiedemann, 2012 ) . Indic languages are slightly over-represented (3/7) reflecting the greater availability of parallel SFT datasets for these languages. Full details are provided in Appendix E .

blocks.en: 4.4 Evaluation
blocks.zh: 4.4 评价

blocks.en:
We evaluate each checkpoint using the lm-eval-harness ( Gao et al., 2024 ) and a wide variety of evaluation tasks, requiring diverse latent capabilities and output formatting.
We use FLORES ( Goyal et al., 2022 ; NLLB Team et al., 2022 ) in the eng → \rightarrow tgt direction to evaluate target language generation and Belebele ( Bandarkar et al., 2024 ) for understanding.
To evaluate cross-lingual knowledge transfer, we use the medicine subset of Global-MMLU ( Singh et al., 2025 ) and MMLU-ProX ( Xuan et al., 2025 ) , and use MultiLoKo ( Hupkes and Bogoychev, 2025 ) and INCLUDE ( Romanou et al., 2025 ) for “local” knowledge. Global-PIQA ( Chang et al., 2025 ) evaluates the transfer of physical reasoning.
Finally, we evaluate mathematical reasoning with MGSM ( Shi et al., 2023 ) (which includes Global-MGSM ( Cohere Labs, n.d. ) , an extension to more languages) and PolyMath ( Wang et al., 2025 ) .
Because benchmark language coverage varies, the number of available tasks differs across target languages ranging from four for Kyrgyz to nine for Vietnamese.

blocks.en:
We first analyze the impact of adding our routing loss to cross-lingual alignment metrics. We use FLoRES evaluation data ( NLLB Team et al., 2022 ) , out-of-distribution relative to any training sets, to measure this alignment. We first measure MoE routing alignment to English using the routing divergence metric proposed by Bandarkar et al. (2026c) . Inadvertently, the per-model hyperparameters induced varying magnitudes of changes to model routing than others. In constrast, baseline CPT led to only minor changes in routing relative to the original checkpoint.

blocks.en: MoE router alignment does not directly imply hidden state representation alignment. But Gradients from the routing loss propagate through preceding model parameters. We therefore evaluate whether the routing loss also changes the underlying hidden state representations, rather than only the router outputs. Moreover, activating similar experts may increase representational similarity in subsequent layers. To measure the impact on underlying representations, we perform forward passes on the same parallel data and collect the hidden states at two points each decoder layer: entering the layer and the hidden state after the attention block 1 1 1 Concretely, this is the hidden state entering the MoE block, right after the residual connection is re-added. . Then, we calculate the SoftCKA cross-lingual alignment metric from Bandarkar et al. (2026b) . Rather than mean-pooling, this calculates within-sequence and cross-language RBF kernel matrices to soft-match tokens. This allows us to use centered kernel alignment (CKA) ( Kornblith et al., 2019 ) without explicitly matching tokens across sequences. This metric is displayed for Qwen3 in Figure 4 . It clearly displays that across languages, our MoE alignment metric is making representations, themselves, more similar to English.

blocks.en:
Because benchmark coverage differs by language, Table 1 reports the average over all available tasks for each model–language pair; task-level scores and complete training configurations are provided in Appendix B .
The baseline itself yields only modest gains over the original checkpoint, so differences between experimental conditions are also relatively small.
At the individual task level, there is noise. However, the language-level averages show a consistent trend. The routing loss improves over this baseline for 13 of the 14 model–language pairs and ties for the remaining pair (Marco-Nano on Vietnamese). The positive gains range up to 2.1 average points, with a mean improvement of 0.9 points across all pairs.
This gains are observed despite the relatively short CPT stage applied earlier to already post-trained checkpoints.

尽管欧洲防止酷刑委员会较早阶段适用于已经经过培训的检查站,但可以看到这一进展。

blocks.en: Table 2 summarizes the comparison to mean-pooling hidden states using cosine similarity ( ℒ X ​ L ​ H \mathcal{L}_{XLH} ). The hidden-state objective is competitive on Sinhala, improving the baseline average from 26.1 to 26.3, but remains below the 26.8 obtained with ℒ X ​ L ​ R \mathcal{L}_{XLR} . On Hungarian, hidden-state alignment actually decreases the baseline score from 37.4 to 36.9, whereas routing alignment increases it to 38.1. Thus, in both tested settings, mean-pooled router distributions provide a more effective alignment target than mean-pooled hidden representations. Because this ablation covers only Marco-Nano and two languages, we view it as targeted support for our design choice rather than a comprehensive comparison of representation-alignment methods.
blocks.zh: 表2总结了使用余弦相似度(LX L H\ mathcal{L}_{XLH})与平均集合隐藏状态的比较. 隐藏状态目标在僧伽罗语上具有竞争力,使基线平均值从26.1提高到26.3,但仍低于用L X L R\Mathcal{L}_{XL}_{XLR}获得的26.8. 在匈牙利语中,隐藏状态对齐实际上将基线得分从37.4降至36.9,而路由对齐将其增加到38.1。 因此,在两个被测试的设置中,平均集合路由器分布提供了比平均集合隐藏表达更为有效的对齐目标. 由于这种淡化只涵盖马可-纳诺语和两种语言,我们认为它是对我们设计选择的有针对性的支持,而不是对代表-调整方法的全面比较.

blocks.en:
We next analyze the router-only training condition.
Despite updating fewer than < 0.1 % <0.1\% of params, it ocasionally matches or exceeds the LM-only baseline, although performance varies substantially across settings.
Its changes to the internal alignment metrics are similarly noisy.
These results suggest that router-only training may provide a parameter-efficient alternative, although it is not a reliable substitute for full-model training.
Taken together, these results suggest that the gains from the routing loss arise primarily from changes to the representations supplied to the routers, rather than the updates to the routing function alone.
blocks.zh:
接下来我们只分析路由器的训练条件
尽管更新的参数小于 < 0.1% < 0.1 +%,但它与LM 基准相匹配或超过该基准,尽管各设置的性能差异很大。
它对内部对齐度量的改变同样也非常吵闹。
这些结果表明,只有路由器的培训可能提供一个具有参数效率的替代方案,尽管它不能可靠地替代全模培训。
总而言之,这些结果表明,路由损失的收益主要来自向路由器提供的表述的变化,而不是仅对路由功能的更新。

blocks.en: 6 Discussion and Future Work
blocks.zh: 6. 讨论和今后的工作

blocks.en: In order to evaluate the impact of our training method on downstream tasks, we were constrained to experiment on fully post-trained LLMs. Using base models would lead to noisy evaluations, given they would not have learned to reason, perform chain-of-thought, follow instructions, etc. On the other hand, the abundant parallel data available is largely unlabeled, requiring us to do CPT. CPT on post-trained LLMs is sensitive and inefficient, as is reflected in the very limited gains by the baseline. We elect such an experimental setting to control for the influence of the routing loss on downstream evaluations, likely at the expense of bigger experimental deltas.
blocks.zh: 为了评估我们的培训方法对下游任务的影响,我们不得不对经过充分培训的法学硕士进行试验。 使用基准模型会导致评价的噪音,因为这些模型不会学会讲道理、执行思维链、遵守指示等。 另一方面,现有的大量并行数据基本上没有标签,需要我们进行欧洲防止酷刑委员会。 欧禁酷委在经过培训后开办的法学课程很敏感,效率低下,基线的成绩非常有限就反映了这一点。 我们选择这样一个实验环境来控制路径损失对下游评价的影响,可能牺牲更大的实验三角洲。

blocks.en:
We believe this method would be much more effective during pretraining rather than post-training because that would compound all the learnings from pre-, mid-, and post-training to be tied together across languages more natively.
In addition, recent studies suggest MoE routing dynamics are established quite early on in pretraining ( Xue et al., 2024 ; Muennighoff et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh:
我们认为,在培训前而不是培训后,这种方法将更为有效,因为这将使培训前、中、培训后的所有学习更加结合,在语言之间更加本土化。
此外,最近的研究表明,教育部的路线动态在预训中很早就确定(薛等人,2024年;Muennighoff等人,2025年)。

blocks.en:
Naturally, this method is entirely reliant on parallel data. This restricts its applicability because much of the data used for pre-training, mid-training, SFT or RL is not parallel.
Existing parallel corpora are also predominantly sentence-level and cover a relatively narrow data distribution. As can be seen in our baseline, where the model only improved a small amount during a CPT of 200k training samples, this data on its own cannot substantially improve a model on downstream tasks. We therefore view MoE alignment as one component of a broader training curriculum, interleaved with stages that optimize on complementary data distributions.
blocks.zh:
自然,这种方法完全依赖于并行数据. 这限制了其适用性,因为用于预训、中训、SFT或RL的大部分数据并不平行。
现有的平行的corpora也主要是句子级别,覆盖了相对狭窄的数据分布. 从我们的基线中可以看出,在200k培训样本的CPT中,模型只改进了少量,而这一数据本身无法大大改进下游任务的模型。 因此,我们认为,教育部的协调统一是更广泛的培训课程的一个组成部分,与优化补充数据分配的各个阶段相互衔接。

blocks.en: Often, the term contrastive learning implies the presence of positive and negative pairs. The purpose of the negative pairs is to prevent representation collapse ( van den Oord et al., 2018 ) . However, the negative pairs are unnecessary here as MoE LLMs are always trained with load-balancing (another auxiliary loss), which incentivizes equitable use of experts across different batch sizes. In our experiments, our alignment loss is only done at a small-scale, with low risk of collapsing the router distributions. As a result, we do not experiment with negative pairs nor with the interaction with load-balancing auxiliary loss. We leave this to future work, as such experiments would likely require large-scale (i.e. expensive) pretraining.
blocks.zh: 比较性学习一词往往意味着存在正对和负对. 负对的目的是防止代表崩溃(van den Oord et al., 2018). 然而,这里的负对是不必要的,因为教育部有限责任公司总是接受负载平衡培训(另一种辅助损失),这鼓励公平使用不同批量规模的专家。 在我们的实验中,我们的对齐损失只是小规模的,低风险会崩溃路由器分配. 因此,我们不试验负对,也不试验负负负平衡辅助损失的相互作用。 我们把这项工作留给今后的工作,因为这种实验可能需要大规模(即昂贵的)预先训练。

blocks.en:
Based on prior work ( Zhu et al., 2024 ; Yoon et al., 2024 ; Hu et al., 2025 ) , we additionally hypothesize that alignment may be more beneficial for tasks that depend less strongly on language-specific information, like reasoning, math, knowledge, etc.
However, our results do not establish convincingly that router alignment benefits such tasks more than translation and reading comprehension.
blocks.zh:
基于之前的工作(朱 et等人,2024年;尹 al等人,2024年;胡 et等人,2025年),我们进一步假设,对调可能对较少依赖语言特定信息的任务更有利,如推理,数学,知识等.
然而,我们的结果并没有令人信服地证明,路由器的调整比翻译和阅读理解更有利于这些任务。

blocks.en: In traditional CPT, the LM loss comes from the logit distribution, which is subject to a gradient bottleneck during backpropagation through the softmax operation ( Godey and Artzi, 2026 ) . Auxiliary internal losses such as MoE load-balancing and our routing divergence loss, provide more direct supervision to early-layer parameters helping mitigate vanishing or exploding gradients ( Lee et al., 2015 ; Kedia et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 在传统的CPT中,LM损失来自logit分布,在通过软max操作(Godey and Artzi, 2026)进行反向传播时受到梯度瓶颈. 辅助性内部损失,如教育部的负载平衡和我们的径向差损失,为早期参数提供了更直接的监督,有助于减轻消失或爆炸梯度(Lee等人,2015年;Kedia等人,2024年;Li等人,2025年)。

blocks.en: While contrastive learning has been standard practice in encoder-based architectures ( Radford et al., 2021 ) , modern multimodal generative models do not use such supervision ( Wang et al., 2024b ) . Recent work has further identified modality-dependent routing discrepancies in multimodal MoE models that can hinder the activation of task-relevant reasoning experts ( Xu et al., 2026 ) . Future work could investigate whether MoE-based alignment could facilitate cross-modal alignment and improve reasoning capabilities across modalities.
blocks.zh: 虽然对比性学习一直是基于编码器的建筑的标准实践(Radford等人,2021年),但现代的多式联运基因模型并没有使用这种监督(Wang等人,2024年b). 最近的工作进一步查明了多式联运模式中依赖模式的路由差异,这些差异可能阻碍与任务有关的推理专家的启动(徐等人,2026年)。 今后的工作可以调查基于教育部的调整能否促进跨模式的调整,提高各种模式的推理能力。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: This work introduces a cross-lingual alignment objective for decoder-only MoE language models that minimizes the divergence between mean-pooled routing distributions for translated sequences. Grounded in recent LLM research on multilinguality, our method provides a pragmatic way to introduce sequence-level cross-lingual supervision into modern decoder-only architectures without requiring token-level correspondence. We find that its impact extends beyond the explicit routing objective by also aligning the model’s hidden representations. Consistent with the hypothesis that representational alignment facilitates cross-lingual transfer, these internal changes yield positive aggregate gains across diverse multilingual evaluations, even within our limited-scale post-training setting. Together, these results provide empirical support for the role of cross-lingual alignment in multilingual transfer and demonstrate that it can be directly encouraged in MoE LLMs.
blocks.zh: 这部作品引入了一个跨语言对齐目标,用于解码器唯一的MOE语言模型,最大限度地缩小翻译序列的平均集合路由分布之间的差异. 基于最近关于多语言性的LLM研究,我们的方法提供了一个务实的方法,将序列级的跨语言监督引入现代解码器唯一的架构,而不需要符号级的通信. 我们发现,它的影响超出了明确的路线目标,因为它也调整了模型的隐藏表述。 这些内部变化符合一种假设,即代表协调有助于跨语言的转让,因此,即使在我们有限的培训后环境中,在多种语言的评价中,这些内部变化也产生了积极的总体收益。 这些成果共同为跨语种协调在多语种转让中的作用提供了经验性支持,并表明可以在教育部法学硕士中直接加以鼓励。

blocks.en: These findings establish MoE routing as a promising interface for inducing cross-lingual transfer in modern LLMs. Future work could develop objectives that reduce token-level information loss, determine when and where alignment supervision is most effective within a model’s training curriculum, and reduce reliance on explicitly parallel data. Studying these questions at pretraining scale may reveal more general ways to encourage shared representations without sacrificing language- or modality-specific structure.
blocks.zh: 这些发现将教育部的路由定位确定为在现代法学硕士中诱导跨语言转移的有希望的界面。 今后的工作可以制定减少象征性信息损失的目标,确定在模型的培训课程中何时何地进行协调统一监督最为有效,并减少对明确平行数据的依赖。 在训练前规模上研究这些问题,可能揭示出更普遍的方式,在不牺牲语言或方式特定结构的情况下鼓励分享表述。

blocks.en: We construct a separate English–target-language parallel dataset for each of the seven languages in our experiments. Each dataset targets 200,000 training examples, with 1,000 additional examples reserved for validation. The examples comprise both sentence-aligned bitext and parallel instruction–response conversations. For instruction-tuning sources, we align the English and target-language versions of the same example and preserve their multi-turn chat structure. We remove empty pairs, pairs whose two sides are identical, and duplicate pairs from the same source.

This prevents poorly tokenized examples from producing disproportionately long sequences while retaining the same filtering procedure across sources.

blocks.en: Appendix F Training Details
blocks.zh: 附录F 培训详情

blocks.en: Section 4.2 describes the training setup and some hyperparameters. All remaining training settings are fixed across experiments. Each run consists of one epoch over 200,000 training examples. We use a warmup–stable–decay (WSD) learning-rate schedule, with a linear warmup over the first 10,000 examples and a decay over the final 40,000 examples. The intervening 150,000 examples therefore use a constant learning rate. We optimize with the fused PyTorch implementation of AdamW and do not apply NEFTune. Although the per-device batch size varies with the memory requirements of each model, we adjust the number of gradient-accumulation steps to maintain an effective batch size of 32 examples.
blocks.zh: 第4.2节描述了培训设置和一些超参数。 所有剩余的培训环境都固定在各种实验中。 每次运行包括一个20多万个培训实例。 我们使用一个温暖-稳定-减速(WSD)学习率时间表,在前10000个例子中呈现线性热量,在最后的40,000个例子中呈现衰减。 因此,干预的15万个例子使用不断的学习率。 我们优化了 AdamW的PyTorch系统 并且不应用NEFTune系统 虽然每个设备的批量大小随每个模型的内存要求而不同,但我们调整梯度积分步骤的数量,以保持有效批量大小32例.

blocks.en: The two larger models require fully sharded data parallelism (FSDP) across multiple GPUs with 80 GB of memory: GPT-OSS-20B uses three or four GPUs, depending on the run, while Qwen3-30B-A3B uses four. In contrast, Granite-4.0-H-Tiny and Marco-Nano each fit on a single GPU. Training Granite-4.0-H-Tiny and Marco-Nano on one GPU is comparatively slow, with a run taking approximately 15 hours on H100 or A100.
